pricing.details: Free: unlimited songs on the latest model, lyrics and editing, downloads in every format (OGG, MP3, WAV, FLAC, M4A), and no usage restrictions from Treblo on songs you create. Standard generation queue, 4 songs at once. Pro: 9 €/month, or 72 €/year (6 €/month billed yearly, officially 33% less). Pro adds no ads, priority queue, 10 songs at once, covers in a new style (beta), reuse styles (beta), sing in your own voice (beta), avoid unwanted styles, legacy models (v2.2 and Classic lyrics), high-quality stems (beta), a Pro badge and Discord role. Beta features can change, break or be removed... Cancel anytime; songs stay in your library if you cancel.
